tei:div.tei:p: "!#༁ྃ: bla ma dgongs 'dus kyi bka' srung chos srung gter srung gi gtor chog rgyun khyer bsdus pa bzhugs so:

hrī: stong nyid spros bral chos dbyings dag pa las: rig pa ye shes phyag rgya'i skur gsal ba'i: shes rab rang snang khro rgyal dbang gi lha: yab yum sras dang 'khor dang sprul pa bcas: zhi ba'i ngang las drag po'i skur bzhengs la: dbang gi rta skad mtsher zhing da tshur byon: rdzu 'phrul shugs kyis gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol: yum chen e ka dzā ṭi gshegs su gsol: sras mchog gnod sbyin shan pa gshegs su gsol: bka' sdod sde brgyad 'khor bcas gshegs su gsol: gnod byed pho mo bsnol ba'i gdan steng du: khro rgyal rta mgrin nag po 'khor bcas rnams: dgyes pa'i tshul gyis brtan par bzhugs su gsol: ha ya grī wa e ka dzā ṭi yaksha yaksha sa ma ya: e hye hi sa pa ri wā ra sa ma ya dzaḥdza: dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ ho: sa ma ya st+waṃ: tiṣṭha lhan: badzra sa ma ya hūm̐: a ti pū ho: pra tī dza ho: hrī: khro rgyal sku la nyon mongs mi mnga' yang: 'gro ba'i nyon mongs las sgrib sbyang slad du: yan lag brgyad ldan rnam par dag pa'i chab: 'ja' tshon sna tshogs mdog 'dra'i me tog dang: mkha' dbyings sprin tshogs lta bu'i bdug spos dang: nyi zla lta bur gsal ba'i mar me dang: bdud rtsi lta bu'i byug mchog dam pa dang: ri rab lta bur brjid pa'i zhal zas dang: tshangs pa'i dbyangs snyan rol mo'i mchod pa dang: rakta'i yon chab dbang po'i me tog dang: gsur chen bdug spos zhun chen gsal ba'i me: mkhris sbyar gsang chen dri chab māṃ sa'i bshos: rkang gling thod rnga'i sgra chen la sogs dang: lhan cig skyes sbyor zung 'jug dam pa'i rdzas: rtsa brgyad yan lag stong la sbyar ba'i sman: gnod byed dgra bgegs bsgral pa'i khrag chen po: gtor ma'i ngo bo ye shes rgya mtsho'i tshogs: rta mgrin nag po 'khor dang bcas la 'bul: thugs dam gnyan po bskang phyir bzhes su gsol: rnal 'byor bsam pa bsgrub phyir bzhes su gsol: gnod byed dgra bgegs bsgral phyir bzhes su gsol:

sangs rgyas bstan pa bsrung phyir bzhes su gsol: bzhes nas las kyi 'bras bu mchis par mdzod: oṃ āḥhūm̐: oṃ karma kro dha ha ya grī wa: kro dhī shwa ri e ka dzā ṭī: yaksha yaksha: rā tsa traka raksha: kha mun tra: tri du ru: du du ha ra ti: shu la ra tri badzra sā dhu rā tsa yaksha: nā ga rā tsa: rā hu la i daṃ ba liṃ ta kha kha khā hi khā hi: sarba pañtsa a mṛta kha raṃ khā hi: ma hā rakta dzwa la maṇḍa la pū dza khā hi: gu hya ma hā su kha pū dza ho: ma hā maṇḍal pū dza ho: āoṃ badzra arghaṃ sogs puṣpe dhū pe ā lo ke gandhe nai wi dyā shabda pū dza āḥhūm̐: hrī: chos nyid zhi ba'i ngang las ma g.yos kyang: gdug pa can rnams snying rjes rab sgrol ba: bdud bzhi'i dpung 'joms dpa' bo rta mgrin dpal: gar gyi dbang phyug sku la phyag 'tshal bstod: che btsan dpe med khams gsum 'gran zla med: sku mdog nag rngam rab brjid 'jigs pa'i sku: 'khor du lha srin gdug pa'i tshogs kyis bskor: yab yum sras 'khor bcas la phyag 'tshal bstod: hūm̐ hrī: lha yi lha mchog padma dbang gi lha: dus rnams rtag tu khro rgyal khyod bsgrubs te: srog gi phyir yang yi dam mi spong na: ye shes thugs rje'i spyan gyis gzigs su gsol: khro rgyal 'khor bcas khyod kyi gzi brjid kyis: bar chad bgegs kyi tshogs rnams bsal nas kyang: byams pa'i zhal bzang dngos su bstan pa dang: sgrub pa'i 'bras bu dus 'dir bstan du gsol: oṃ āḥhūm̐ gu ru dhe wa dhā ki nī ha ya grī wa sarba siddhi hūm̐: de nas bsnyen pa'i man ngag tu 'dug pa ni: āoṃ hya ghrī wa hūm̐: aḥyaḥmaḥduḥruḥtsaḥshaḥnaḥtsitta hrīng hrīng dza: ces bzla'o: hūm̐: ljon shing brag ris gtams pa'i pho brang nas: sangs rgyas bstan pa srung ba'i mthu rtsal can: btsan rgod 'bar ba ma rungs mched sde bdun: dam tshig dbang gis gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol: srung ma klu btsan 'bar ba spun bdun la:

'khor du btsan rgod sum brgya drug cus bskor: dpal gyi bka' nyan dge bsnyen mched bdun la: dkor bdag skyes bu chen po stong sdes bskor: nor srung rgyal po gnod sbyin mched bdun la: dngos grub ster mdzad gnod sbyin sa yas bskor: kun kyang dpal gyi bka' nyan mthu rtsal can: sprul pa yang sprul 'khor dang bcas pa rnams: sngon tshe slob dpon padma'i spyan snga ru: khas blangs dam bcas bzhin du da tshur byon: nā ga tsant+ri ta sa ma ya dza dza: dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ ho: hrī: sangs rgyas bstan pa srung ba'i mthu rtsal can: btsan rgod dge bsnyen gnod sbyin 'khor bcas la: dkar gsum mngar gsum sha khrag la sogs pa: rang rang dgyes pa'i rdzas mchog gtor ma 'bul: thugs dam gnyan po bskang phyir bzhes su gsol: gzugs sgra dri ro reg bya la sogs pa: phyi nang gsang ba bkod pa'i mchod pa 'bul: sha khrag dmar gyis brgyan pa'i gtor chen po: dam rdzas bdud rtsir byin gyis brlabs pa 'di: 'bar ba spun bdun 'khor dang bcas la 'bul: sprul pa yang sprul tshogs rnams dgyes par rol: zhi rgyas dbang dang drag po la sogs pa'i: phrin las rnam bzhi'i las rnams 'grub par mdzod: ma hā māṃ sa la khā hi: ma hā rakta la khā hi: ma hā tsitta la khā hi: ma hā kiṃ ni ri ti la khā hi: ma hā ba liṃ ta la khā hi: ma hā ga ṇa pū dza la kha kha khā hi khā hi: hrī: mchod do bstod do srung ma'i tshogs: btsan rgod 'bar ba mthu rtsal can: sprul pa'i klu btsan rgyug pa'i tshe: dgra dang bgegs kyi srog rtsa gcod: dge bsnyen chen por sprul tsa na: ma rungs 'jigs pa'i cho 'phrul can: gnod sbyin chen por sprul pa'i tshe: sgrub pa po la dngos grub stengs: mi brdzu dgu brdzu stobs po che: sangs rgyas bstan pa'i bya ra ba: rin chen gter gyi srung ma mchog: rdzu 'phrul can la bdag bstod do: rang rang dgyes pa'i mchod gtor 'bul: thugs dam gnyan po des bskangs la:

sngar byas las kyi gtang rag dang: phyis byed las kyi gnyer zas mdzod: sdang ba'i dgra bo rtsad nas chod: gnod byed bgegs kyi dmag dpung shigs: dgra bgegs ma lus cham la phob: nyin gsum nyin gyi bya ra dang: mtshan gsum mtshan gyi mel tshe gyis: bdag la sdang ba'i dgra byung na: gnyen 'dun yin yang myur du sgrol: sngon gyi dam tshig dgyes dgongs la: bcol ba'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod: phyi nang gsang gsum gyi dril sgrub sngags ni: oṃ nā ga tsant+ri tsa ra rā tri: ging ka ra: yaksha yaksha sa ma ya hūm̐ phaṭa: ces bzla'o: hūm̐ bhyo: sangs rgyas bstan pa gnyan po srung ba dang: gsang sngags bka' yi srung ma mthu mo che: rnal 'byor sgrub pa po yi dgra bla mo: sha za dhā ki bdud mo kha mo che: skad cig nyid la gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol: gnod byed dgra bgegs bsgral pa'i gdan la bzhugs: khyod sngon slob dpon padma thod phreng gis: dpal gyi bsam yas mchims phu'i ge gong du: rtsa gsum lha yi dkyil 'khor zhal phyes nas: yang zab bka' yi chos srung gnyer byang gtad: nam zhig las ldan bstan pa spel ba'i tshe: bshad sgrub bstan pa mtha' ru rgyas byed cing: dam ldan rnal 'byor bu bzhin skyong dgos pa'i: bka' bsgos dam tshig rdo rje spyi bor bzhag: ci ltar rgyal ba'i bka' las ma 'da' bar: dngos 'byor yid sprul mthun rdzas dpag med pa: sman rag gtor ma'i mchod pa 'di bzhes la: rnal 'byor bdag cag 'khor dang bcas pa yi: sngon las 'phral rkyen bar chad zhi ba dang: tshe dpal longs spyod mnga' thang rgyas pa dang: phrin las rnam bzhi lhun gyis grub par mdzod: mi dang mi min bar chad zhi bar mdzod: bshad sgrub bstan pa dus 'dir rgyas par mdzod: dbang sdud lha mi dbang du 'du bar mdzod: ma hā rakta su rā ke: su ro ki: ba su ta hūm̐ hrī ṭhā: lan gsum: bhyo sha za dhā ki ma mo sa pa ri wā ra ba liṃ ta khā hi: nṛ tri ma hā rakta su rā kiṃ ni ri ti ba su ta kha kha khā hi khā hi:

bdun gyis 'bul: bsnyen sngags ni: bhyo sha za dhā ki ma mo tsitta hrīṃ hrīṃ dza: zhes bzla: ༈ skong ba bsdus pa ni: hūm̐ hrī: zla gam dmar po dbang gi dkyil 'khor nas: rigs kyi bdag po snang ba mtha' yas ni: ma chags skyon bral yon tan rdzogs pa'i sku: 'dus pa kun gyi gtsug rgyan thugs dam bskang: dus gsum rgyal ba kun gyis rab bsngags shing: pad sdong las byung mtsho skyes 'gyur med pa: ngo bo gcig las rnam 'phrul dpag med 'gyed: rdo rje padma 'byung gnas thugs dam bskang: shes rab dpal phreng mkha' 'gro yongs kyi gtso: gnyis med dag pa dga' bzhi'i ye shes skyed: dbyings kyi yum chen bde stong zag pa med: lha lcam mandā ra ba'i thugs dam bskang: dus gsum sangs rgyas kun gyi dgongs pa 'dus: yon tan phrin las mi zad dpal 'bar ba: mtshan dang dpe byad byin rlabs kun gyi mdzod: dus gsum bla ma rnams kyi thugs dam bskang: dpal chen zhi khro yab yum sras dang bcas: rnam 'gyur cha lugs sprul bsgyur du ma'i bdag: dkyil 'khor dgu rdzogs dngos grub mdzod chen po: yi dam lha tshogs rnams kyi thugs dam bskang: pho rgyud che btsan dpa' bo rta mchog dpal: gar gyi dbang phyug srid gsum 'gran zla med: zhi khro 'bar ba snang stong sgyu ma'i sku: stobs chen ma rungs 'dul mdzad thugs dam bskang: de yi yum mchog rdo rje phag mo'i sku: mo rgyud che btsan rtog med mkha' dbyings ma: stong nyid ye shes spyi dpal dhā ki'i tshul: 'gyur med don ston ma yi thugs dam bskang: rnal 'byor srog 'dzin bstan pa'i bya ra ma: sprul pa'i gar bsgyur phrin las thogs med sgrub: mthu stobs pho nya myur mgyogs glog ltar 'khyug: ma mo mkha' 'gro'i tshogs kyi thugs dam bskang: phyogs bcu'i zhing khams rgya mtsho mtha' yas kyi: bla ma dkon mchog yi dam 'phags pa'i tshogs: dpa' bo mkha' 'gro chos skyong thams cad dang:

bka' srung mchod pa'i rten gyur thams cad la: lha mi'i mchod rdzas rnam dag rnam mang po: dngos bshams yid sprul rgyan gyis brgyan pa gang: phyi nang gsang bkod mchod pa'i bye brag rnams: mos blos 'bul gyis bzhes la thugs dam bskang: me tog bdug spos snang gsal dri zhal zas: gdugs dang rgyal mtshan ba dan cod pan 'phur: gzugs sgra dri ro reg bya 'dod yon rdzas: phyi mchod rnam dag 'bul gyis thugs dam bskang: snod bcud lus dang longs spyod las byung ba'i: rgyan gyi rnam 'gyur gar stabs sgyur la sogs: 'byung ba lngas bsdus nang gi mchod pa 'di: tshogs gnyis spel phyir 'bul gyis thugs dam bskang: sbyor sgrol dug lnga dug gsum sha rus bcas: dbang lnga sman raka gtor ma thod gling sgra: dkar dmar 'bar 'dzag ga ṇa tsa kras bskor: gsang mchod ting 'dzin bskyed phyir bzhes su gsol: 'jig rten 'di 'am 'jig rten las 'das pa'i: mchod pa'i rnam grangs mchod 'os ci mchis pa: bkod pa khyad par 'phags pa'i tshogs kun kyang: yongs rdzogs lha la 'bul gyis thugs dam bskang: hūm̐ hrī: thugs dam gnyan po skong ba'i dam rdzas ni: dngos su 'byor bshams yid kyis rnam sprul pa'i: gzugs sgra dri ro reg bya chos la sogs: phyi nang gsang mchod sman rag gtor ma dang: gha na'i longs spyod skye 'gro'i gzugs snang bcas: bza' dang bca' dang btung ba'i bye brag dang: thabs dang shes rab las byung bcud chen po: mchog chen mchog phran mtshan ldan za le 'bri: shel sgong lug dang tsa ra mkha' lding mdangs: dbang po'i me tog gsur chen bdug spos dri: zhun chen snang gsal rdo rje dri yi chu: sha rus zhal zas rkang gling thod rnga'i sgra: snyan pa'i dbyangs dang mthun pa'i rdzas la sogs: thun mong khyad par rmad du byung ba yis: khyed rnams thugs dam gnyan po bskang gyur cig: khyed rnams thugs dam gnyan po bskangs nas kyang: bdag cag dpon slob rgyu sbyor 'khor bcas kyi:

dam tshig nyams chag 'gal 'khrul sor chud nas: 'dod pa'i don rnams myur du 'grub pa dang: mchog dang thun mong dngos grub bstsal du gsol: hūm̐ hrī: mchod du med de gnyis med rol pas mchod: bskang du med de skye med ngang du bskang: sbyor du med de zung 'jug chen por sbyor: bsgral du med de mnyam nyid chen por bsgral: ye sbyor ye sgrol chen po'i thugs dam bskang: hrī: dbang chen me rlung 'khrug pa'i dkyil 'khor nas: rab 'jigs dur khrod 'bar ba'i gzhal yas su: dbang gi dbang mchog rta mgrin dbang gi lha: yab yum sras 'khor bcas pa thams cad la: 'dod chags zhe sdang gti mug las byung ba'i: nyon mongs sha khrag rus pa'i mchod pa 'bul: thugs dam gnyan po bskang phyir bzhes su gsol: dngos su 'byor dang yid kyis rnam sprul pa'i: 'dod yon rab rgyas sman rag gtor tshogs 'dis: dpa' bo rta mgrin rgyal po'i thugs dam bskang: gnod byed dgra bgegs bsgral phyir bzhes su gsol: yum mchog e ka tsā ti'i thugs dam bskang: gnod byed dgra bgegs bsgral phyir bzhes su gsol: sras mchog gnod sbyin dmar po'i thugs dam bskang: gnod byed dgra bgegs bsgral phyir bzhes su gsol: pho nya las mkhan sprul pa la sogs pa: bka' yi lha srin sde brgyad thugs ngam bskang: gnod byed dgra bgegs bsgral phyir bzhes su gsol: phyi nang bstan pa srung bar khas blangs pa'i: sha za kha mo che yi thugs dam bskang: nag mo dred mo'i gdong dang ce spyang gdong: spyang gdong wa gdong rnams kyi thugs dam bskang: sha za sman mo klu mo btsan mo sogs: srung ma dam can rnams kyi thugs dam bskang: gnod byed dgra bgegs bsgral phyir bzhes su gsol: klu btsan 'bar ba spun bdun thugs dam bskang: btsan 'khor sum brgya drug cu'i thugs dam bskang: rā tsa dge bsnyen mched bdun thugs dam bskang: dkor bdag skyes bu stong sde'i thugs dam bskang:

nor lha gnod sbyin mched bdun thugs dam bskang: gter bdag gnod sbyin sa ya'i thugs dam bskang: sman dang rakta bdud rtsi'i khu ba bcas: sbrus pa'i arghaṃ 'bras chen gtsang ma'i bshos: byug pa'i zhun chen bdug pa'i gsur chen dri: mdzes pa'i ba dan g.yab dar brten pa'i rdzas: stag gzigs rgyal mtshan mdung dmar ba dan bcas: thugs dam gnyan po bskang phyir bzhes su gsol: khyed kyi thugs dam gnyan po des bskangs la: bdag gi bcol pa'i phrin las grub par mdzod: gzugs sgra dri ro reg bya la sogs pa: 'dod yon lnga las byung ba'i tshogs mchod 'dis: rta mgrin nag po yab yum sras dang 'khor: klu btsan dge bsnyen gnod sbyin mched bdun dang: dhā ki kha mo che yi thugs dam bskang: thugs dam bskangs nas drag po'i phrin las mdzod: sdang ba'i dgra dang gnod par byed pa'i bgegs: za ba'i 'dre dang phung ba'i sri la sogs: bstan la 'tshe zhing sems can yongs la gnod: bsgral ba'i zhing du gyur pa gang yin rnams: 'khor bcas khyed kyis myur bsgral phrin las mdzod: pha rol mi dang mi ma yin pa yi: bsam sbyor ngan pa thams cad bzlog tu gsol: oṃ āḥhūm̐ ho: bdag cag ma rig lus dang ngag sems kyis: sku gsung thugs dang rtsa ba yan lag gi: dam tshig nyams chag 'gal 'khrul ci mchis pa: mthol lo bshags so byang zhing dag gyur cig: ༈

de nas bskul pa bsdus pa ni/ hūm̐: ma g.yel ma g.yel bla ma rig 'dzin tshogs: chos sku skye ba med pa'i ngang nyid las: skye ba'i cho 'phrul longs spyod rdzogs skur sprul: sprul skus 'gro ba 'dren don mdzad pa yi: phyogs bcu dus gsum bde gshegs bcom ldan 'das: don dam spros bral bla ma chos kyi sku: mtshan dpes rab brgyan bla ma longs spyod rdzogs: thugs rjes 'gro 'dul bla ma sprul pa'i sku: don gyi dbyings la ca co mi mnga' yang: gang la gang 'dul tshul du dbyings nas bzhengs: bzhengs shig bzhengs shig chos kyi dbyings nas bzhengs: bskul lo bskul lo 'gro ba'i don la skul: mdzod cig mdzod cig mngon spyod phrin las mdzod: sha khrag dmar gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes la: nyon mongs dug lnga'i dgra 'dre dbyings su sgrol: thabs mkhas thugs rje'i sku shugs ma chung bar: sdug bsngal 'khor ba'i 'khrul 'khor bzlog tu gsol: hūm̐: gsang chen rol pa'i dkyil 'khor chen po nas: dgu klong 'khrugs pa e yi gzhal yas khang: 'byung ba rang 'od 'khrugs pa'i dkyil 'khor nas: yi dam mkha' 'gro'i tshogs rnams sku bzhengs 'tshal: bzhengs shig bzhengs shig rang rang gnas nas bzhengs: bskul lo bskul lo thugs dam gnad nas skul: mdzod cig mdzod cig drag po'i phrin las mdzod: padma badzra 'khor bcas sku bzhengs 'tshal: buddha thod phreng 'khor bcas sku bzhengs 'tshal: mi bskyod rdo rje 'khor bcas sku bzhengs 'tshal: padma dbang chen 'khor bcas sku bzhengs 'tshal: thod pa rtsal chen 'khor bcas sku bzhengs 'tshal: drag po me phreng 'khor bcas sku bzhengs 'tshal: sangs rgyas dpa' bo 'khor bcas sku bzhengs 'tshal: dbang chen rta mgrin 'khor bcas sku bzhengs 'tshal: lag na rdo rje 'khor bcas sku bzhengs 'tshal: rang rang gnas nas sku bzhengs 'dir gshegs la: phrin las myur mgyogs drag po'i las mdzod cig: ngang nyid don gyi dbyings las ma g.yos kyang:

gnas skabs gzugs skus 'gro ba'i don mdzad cing: gnod byed gdug pa'i dgra bgegs bsgral ba'i phyir: rnam 'gyur khro tshul 'jigs pa'i cha lugs la: zhal gdangs ljags 'dril mche gtsigs rkan sgra rdeb: spyan gsum dmar po gru gsum sdang mig bgrad: smin ma ag tshom me 'bar gyen du 'phyo: dbu skra ral pa kham nag gtsug tu 'khyil: thod skam rin chen rtse bran sbrul gyis dkris: gzhan yang dur khrod chas dang rus pas brgyan: sna tshogs rin chen dar dang lhab lhub spras: rnam 'gyur dor stabs bgrad cing 'gying bag tshul: mi srun drag shul 'bar ba'i gar stabs 'khyug: zhal nas drag po sngags kyi 'brug sgra sgrog: sha khrag dmar gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes la: gnod byed dgra bgegs thal ba'i rdul du rlogs: hūm̐: snang srid thams cad yum gyi bha ga'i klong: bde stong 'khrugs pa chags pa'i dkyil 'khor nas: dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad skyed mdzad ma: ma mo mkha' 'gro'i tshogs rnams sku bzhengs 'tshal: bzhengs shig bzhengs shig rang bzhin dbyings nas bzhengs: bskul lo bskul lo thugs dam gnad nas skul: mdzod cig mdzod cig drag po'i phrin las mdzod: phyi nang gsang gsum ma mo mkha' 'gro'i tshogs: yongs kyi gtso gyur rdo rje phag mo'i sku: 'khor gyi dhā ki shugs 'gror bcas rnams kyang: rang rang dgyes pa'i mchod gtor 'di bzhes la: phrin las myur mgyogs gnod byed dgra bgegs sgrol: bstan pa srung ba'i las 'di myur du mdzod: ma tshogs dhā ki'i thugs dam dus la bab: hūm̐: sangs rgyas bstan pa srung byed cing: dkyil 'khor mu ran skyong ba yi: chos skyong srung ma mthu rtsal can: khyed kyi dam tshig dus la bab: ma g.yel ma g.yel chos skyong tshogs: bstan pa srung ba'i dus la bab: phrin las sgrub pa'i dus la bab: dgra bgegs bsgral ba'i dus la bab: mthu rtsal phyung ba'i dus la bab: 'bar ma pho nya rdzu 'phrul can:

gar gyi dbang phyug khro rgyal dpal: rta mchog rgyal po he ru ka: don gyis sangs rgyas yin mod kyang: mdzad pa'i cho 'phrul du ma las: rnam pa sna tshogs cha lugs can: bran gyi tshul du bka' srung mdzad: 'khor du sde brgyad tshogs kyis bskor: yab yum sras 'khor yang sprul bcas: 'dir gshegs brgyan pa'i gtor ma bzhes: bcol ba'i phrin las grub par mdzod: hrī: gzhan yang srung ma dam tshig can: phyi nang bka' yi bya ra ba: gtsang rigs dpal mgon bdun cu sogs: dbang phyug ging dang brtan ma dang: 'bar ma pho nya la sogs te: dam can rgya mtsho thams cad kyang: rnam 'gyur cha lugs du ma la: khro gtum 'jigs gzugs rngam pa'i tshul: la la zhi 'dzum sgeg bzhad bcas: gos su shun lpags ro ras dang: zhing lpags dar zab re lde gyon: la la gcer bu ral pa can: de bzhin rgyan yang ma nges shing: thod phreng sbrul sogs dur khrod chas: rin chen rus pa'i rgyan gyis spras: gnas kyang nam mkha'i dbyings la sogs: rgya mtsho dur khrod bas mtha' 'grim: las su sangs rgyas bstan pa srung: zas su sha khrag rkang mar za: skom du khrag rnag chu ser 'thung: bka' srung pho nya las mkhan tshogs: 'bod pa'i dus su snyan ma sra: g.yab pa'i dus su spyan ma rtul: bsten pa'i dus su rgyang ma ring: bskul ba'i tshe na bang ma bul: rbad pa'i dus su mthu ma chung: bcol ba'i tshe na rtsal ma zhan: so sos ji ltar 'dod pa yi: mthun rdzas mchod gtor 'di bzhes la: sngon tshe rgyal ba'i spyan snga ru: ji ltar khas blangs dam bcas ltar: sangs rgyas bstan pa srung ba dang: dkon mchog gsum gyi dbu 'phang bstod: sgrub la bar chad byed pa'i bgegs: mi dang mi min bdud kyi tshogs: thams cad ma lus rdul du rlogs: khas blangs bzhin du bdag gis bskul: dam bcas bzhin du khyod kyis sgrubs: ldem me rgyang nge ma mdzad par: sku shugs phyungs la mthu dpung skyed: sdang bar byed pa'i dgra bo sod:

gnod par byed pa'i bgegs dpung shigs: pha rol bsam sbyor ngan pa zlog: dam tshig can gyi grogs mdzod la: dam nyams rnams kyi snying khrag 'thungs: bka' dang bstan pa srung ba dang: 'khor dang gang zag thams cad skyongs: bdag gis ci ltar bcol ba yi: phrin las ma lus 'grub par mdzod: hūm̐: bdag ni rnal 'byor dam tshig can: rig 'dzin rgyal ba'i zhal tshab che: dbang chen 'bar ba'i sprul pa yin: khyod ni srung ma thugs dam can: rgyal bas bsngags pa'i pho nya ba: chos skyong srung ma mthu rtsal can: dmar gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes la: khyed kyi thugs dam dus la bab: mchims phu'i brag btsan dus la bab: g.yu lung gangs btsan dus la bab: spa ri spa btsan dus la bab: kong ma grib btsan dus la bab: spu ri spu btsan dus la bab: brag dmar rdzong btsan dus la bab: stag ma rong btsan dus la bab: dge bsnyen chen po'i dus la bab: rdo rje drag po'i dus la bab: dbang btsan chen po'i dus la bab: ye shes rtsal gyi dus la bab: rdo rje mchog rgod dus la bab: rdo rje srung ma'i dus la bab: rdo rje dgra 'joms dus la bab: rdo rje legs pa'i dus la bab: gnod sbyin chen po'i dus la bab: gang ba bzang po'i dus la bab: gnod sbyin 'brog gnas dus la bab: yaksha kā la'i dus la bab: gnod sbyin khyung gdong dus la bab: gnod sbyin chu 'beb dus la bab: gnod sbyin gangs dkar dus la bab: gnod sbyin bdud 'joms dus la bab: sprul pa nyi shu rtsa gcig sogs: 'khor dang bcas pa'i dus la bab: bka' yi gtor ma 'di bzhes la: bcol ba'i phrin las grub par mdzod: sa ma ya bhyo bhyo: hūm̐ bhyo: rgya mtsho chen po'i pha rol gyi: 'jig rten mkha' 'gro'i dur khrod der: rakta'i khrag lbu 'khrigs pa la: zhing chen lhu dum brtsegs mar langs: keng rus gram khrod 'khrol ba'i dbus: ce spyang ngar skad kyu ru ru: 'dre srin ha ha'i sgra sgrog pa: 'jigs shing ya nga'i dur khrod nas:

bstan srung ma mo las mkhan ma: sha za dhā ki kha mo che: 'khor bcas 'dir gshegs gtor ma bzhes: sdang ba'i dgra bo rdul du rlogs: bcol ba'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod: bhyo sha za dhā ki dgra bgegs kyi srog la mā ra ya bhyo: de ltar gtor 'bul nyung bsdus dang*/ skong ba/ bskul bsdus bcas cha tshang ba 'di bzhin a rā gas bsgrigs pa la nyes 'gal gang mchis chos skyong srung ma'i tshogs la bshags pas/ 'phral gyi rkyen dang yun gyi sgrib par mi 'gyur zhing*/ dge bas padma badzra myur du 'grub par gyur cig /'di dag thams cad tshig mtshams zur tsam re ma gtogs gter gzhung kho na bsgrigs pas byin rlabs che'o// //
